Colour-cosmetics factory-gate output surged +51.4% YoY in 2024 (MFDS via Personal Care Insights, MEDIUM), a supply push that intensifies competition for placement.

A fragmented, capable supplier tier keeps input-side bargaining power low for colour-cosmetics brands.

MFDS registration exists but is not a scale barrier against the low formulation-and-fill cost of entry.
